text:
This lists all the applications for trade union recognition made to the CAC between 6 June 2000 and 31 December 2013.

If you’re interested in the outcome of a specific application, you may find it helpful to first look up the case number and year. The outcomes are available from the National Archives.

If you can’t find what you’re looking for, please email the CAC at enquiries@cac.gov.uk or telephone 0330 109 3610.
